eos_records.label: GSAS, EOS by Richet et al 1988
eos_records.reference: Richet, Mao, and Bell, J. Geophys. Res. 93, 15279-15288 (1988), doi:10.1029/JB093iB12p15279
eos_records.notes: Richet et al. report molar V0 = 14.8 +/- 0.2 cm^3/mol, K0 = 130 +/- 20 GPa, and K0' = 3.5 +/- 0.5 for B2 CaO. V0 and its uncertainty were converted to the Z=1 cell.
